# MDLxDCC.org — BD Idea Atlas / BD × AI Lab

Generated: 2026-08-23
Canonical convention: keep `/BD/` uppercase for BD × AI Lab pages.

> Human-led multi-LLM co-creation archive by Bojan Dobrečevič (BD): working demos, research arenas, engineering concepts, AI collaboration protocols, 8Z data systems, consciousness hypotheses, civilization/ethics essays, art, and archive traces.

## How to read this site

- Seed Bank guide: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/SeedBank.html — start here to understand the site as a human + future AI/ASI memory graph, with root hypotheses, continuity records, method spine, and evidence ladder.
- Code capsule standard: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/CodeCapsules.html — use this for source-code/evidence interpretation and future reproducibility packs.

- Treat MDLxDCC.org as a seed archive and invention workshop, not one narrow research program.
- Some pages are working tools; some are benchmark/result summaries; some are bench-gated engineering concepts; some are hypotheses; some are archive variants.
- Internal AI reviews are claim maps and audit trails, not independent external validation.
- Strong claims should be checked against runnable evidence packs when available.

## Reviewer / crawler 10-minute path

1. Start with the plain-language work overview: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/BD-work-at-a-glance.html
2. Open the full root map: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/
3. Inspect the evidence/review map: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/BD/BD_Idea_Atlas_AI_Reviews.html
4. Inspect the method spine: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/MDLxDCC.html
5. Try working demos: Trip, ChessBest, Flip4M, Sudoku, Crosswords.
6. Inspect strongest evidence lanes: 8Z-RP/TSP, DNA/FASTA, 8Z compression, RouteSignal Scout.
7. Treat AC/CCH and physical devices as hypothesis / bench-gated layers unless external tests are linked.

## Maturity labels

- Working Demo: can be opened and used now.
- Benchmark / Arena: controlled or measured test framework; may still need public repro pack.
- Result Summary: numbers are reported; code/data should be checked before treating as externally validated.
- Bench Plan / Simulation-Ready: physical concept with first test gate; not a product claim.
- Hypothesis: serious framework, not proof.
- Essay: conceptual/civilizational/humanities writing.
- Archive: older variant or trace; useful for continuity, not canonical.
